newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: TENNIS-KRAJICEK BLASTS 23 ACES ON WAY TO FINAL.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-KRAJICEK BLASTS 23 ACES ON WAY TO FINAL.

text.p: High-class serving by Wimbledon champion Richard Krajicek spurred him to a straight sets victory over third seed Thomas Enqvist of Sweden in the $750,000 World Indoor tournament on Saturday.
Krajicek, winner of the tournament in 1995, blasted 23 aces, bringing his tournament total to 83, and lost only 19 points on his own service. He won 6-7 6-3 6-4.
Four of those points he lost during the first set tiebreak which he contrived to lose 7-5 after building a 4-1 lead.
"I think it was lack of concentration after getting 4-1 ahead so easy," said the Dutch second seed.

Krajicek broke Enqvist in the sixth game of the second set and seventh game of the deciding set, after the Swede had double-faulted twice, to earn his place in the final against either defending champion Goran Ivanisevic or unseeded Czech Daniel Vacek who were playing later.
